sections.Profile:
The Amazing Spider-Man pinball machine, released by Gottlieb in 1980, was a pioneering game in their System 80 series. Designed by Ed Krynski and featuring artwork by Gordon Morison, it showcases vibrant comic book art that closely mirrors the classic Spider-Man comics of the era. This machine is notable for being the first Gottlieb pinball with an attract mode lighting system and having the speaker positioned in the backbox, enhancing the player experience.

- Years made: 1980
